Advise note 1: identikey-auth Response with no linked MXID SHALL fail login. Link only via register or a bind that already requires a valid grant. Add that scenario to the delta spec.

Advise note 2: do not inject epoch(n) as a fact that coexists with authority epoch(m). Authority block has check if epoch($e), device_epoch($e). Verifier injects device_epoch from the device row. Write the epoch-bump test first.

Advise note 3: UserEventPosition for user U and event E is membership of U's latest own m.room.member in that room with stream position below E. Add storage method if needed. Backfill uses the same walk over any member from the origin server.

Advise note 4: may_read_room: either document that world_readable still requires membership in v1, or pass when history_visibility is world_readable AND the requester has a valid grant. Pick one and match the delta.

Advise note 5: fail-closed for foreign allow.room_id stays out of inventing other-room lookup. Leave a comment that event auth (v8+) is join_authorised_via_users_server, not check_allow_conditions as the future home.
Advise note 6: AuthedUser (or the library equivalent) carries the verified Biscuit/authorizer so later attenuation can inject room/operation without re-verifying.
Advise note 7: persist minter private key the same way server signing keys are stored, not hashed.
No HTTP types in conduit. Host maps Bearer to library verify.
